title: Quote Template Logo Permission Consistency

items.action: create a quote template or upload a logo for a new template
update a quote template or upload a replacement logo

database.reason: No persistence schema changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Both permission codes already exist in Core.

audit.reason: Logo upload remains a helper asset operation and existing template create/update audit events are unchanged.

frontend.reason: The existing edit form already exposes logo replacement to users with quote_templates.update.

ui_permissions.reason: No frontend permission gating changes are required once the shared upload endpoint accepts both legitimate writer permissions.

notes: Quote template logo upload is shared by both create and update workflows. The upload endpoint now accepts either quote_templates.create or quote_templates.update, while template POST remains create-only and template PATCH remains update-only. Organization scoping and stored-logo ownership validation are unchanged.
